title: Verdant Ruins: The Navigator's Civic Seed
premise: In a forest city reclaimed by root-powered civic machines, the navigator must synchronize the return route to the signal using a star-and-current sextant.
ending: Recover the Civic Seed and return with the verified return bearing; Green Assembly can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive spore plume while evading the canopy defender without sacrificing the verified return bearing.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Green Assembly to witness the star-and-current sextant.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to accept an unverified coordinate
